escala.foraDoPadrao: non-standard scale: the size in the drawing was rounded
notebook.somenteLeitura: %1 x %2, %3 Hz, %4x: mode and scale set by Omarchy
modo.recusado: %1 does not fit this display's %2x scale; the resolution did not change.
fantasma.aproximada: Approximate size: no rule gives this display's scale, so it was drawn at scale 1.
esquecer.pergunta: Forget %1? Its line leaves the saved arrangement. If it comes back, its monitors.lua rule applies, or it is treated as new.
faixa.notebookDesligado: The laptop panel is off. Turn it on in the Display panel to change the arrangement.
faixa.arquivoInvalido: The saved arrangement is invalid (line %1: %2) and was ignored; the monitors.lua rules apply.
faixa.semRegra: This display cannot be positioned yet. Set its scale once in the Display panel (SUPER + CTRL + D) with the focus on it; Omarchy creates the port rule and it becomes positionable.
faixa.telaNova: New display: %1 (%2). Drag it to where it sits on the desk and apply.
faixa.sobreFantasma: %1 sits over the saved spot of %2, which is disconnected.
faixa.estreito: %1 and %2 touch only along a short edge; the mouse may struggle to move between them.
faixa.maxTelas: More than %1 displays are on, and the panel arranges at most that many.
faixa.edp1Fora: The laptop is not at 0x0. The arrangement is measured from it; check the eDP-1 rule in monitors.lua.
aplicar.semMudanca: Nothing differs from the saved arrangement.
aplicar.bloqueia: The displays must touch without overlapping. Use Fix.
aplicar.somenteLeitura: With the laptop panel off, the arrangement can only be viewed.
eval.porta: Not applied: one of the displays is on an invalid port.
eval.interna: Not applied: the panel never changes the laptop display.
eval.semRegra: Not applied: one of the displays has no rule in monitors.lua.
eval.desc: Not applied: the description of one of the displays is invalid.
eval.modo: Not applied: the mode of one of the displays is invalid.
eval.posicao: Not applied: the position of one of the displays is out of range.
eval.transform: Not applied: the orientation of one of the displays is invalid.
eval.vazio: Not applied: there was nothing to send to Hyprland.
redimensionar.porta: Display %1 is no longer in the arrangement.
redimensionar.interna: The laptop display does not change here: Omarchy owns its mode and scale.
redimensionar.fixa: Display %1 cannot change here (no rule in monitors.lua, or flipped).
aviso.semGuarda: The revert guard could not be armed; nothing was applied.
aviso.evalFalhou: Hyprland rejected the change (%1); the displays go back to their previous state.
aviso.escalaMudou: The scale of %1 changed while applying; the change was reverted.
aviso.outraCoisa: Hyprland applied something else: %1. Revert is selected.
aviso.naoSalvou: Not saved; it holds until the next reload.
aviso.recarregou: The revert did not match; Hyprland was reloaded and is back on the saved arrangement.
aviso.recarregadoNaConfirmacao: Hyprland reloaded during the confirmation and went back to the saved arrangement.
aviso.telaMudou: A display was connected or disconnected during the confirmation; the change was reverted.
aviso.revertidoSemTela: The display on %1 left during the change: the revert left it out and did not reload Hyprland. It gets the saved arrangement on the next reload.
aviso.naoSalvouArquivoInvalido: Not saved: the saved arrangement is invalid and was not overwritten, so its displays are not lost. Fix or delete monitors-arranjo.tsv; the change holds until the next reload.
notif.regraCriada: Display %1 can now be positioned. SUPER + ALT + P.
notif.vao: The display arrangement has a gap. SUPER + ALT + P to fix it.
notif.neutralizacaoFalhou: The new display on %1 does not accept the preferred mode at this port's scale. Set its scale in the Display panel.
notif.salvoFalhou: The display on %1 changed scale when it got its saved values, and went back to what it was. Set its scale in the Display panel.
notif.guarda: Display arrangement reverted: the panel did not respond
motivo.fim: "fim" line missing or out of place
motivo.contagem: the "fim" line count does not match the displays
